paragraphs.notes: Orphan line at the top of the page. It is the tail of the sentence that ends paragraph [0176] on the previous page (Example 17, preparation of the sodium alkoxide), so it carries no marker of its own.

paragraphs.zh: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.1g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.5％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.5％。
paragraphs.en: To the sodium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanolate was added 200 mL THF; after stirring to dissolve, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 degrees C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total charging time being 3 h; after charging was complete the mixture was held at temperature for 3 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 33.1 g of product. HPLC assay gave a content of 97.5％ of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, a two-step yield of 92.5％ calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: This is the closing paragraph of Example 17, which began on the previous page. 2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠 is translated literally as the sodium alkoxide (sodium salt) of 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol, i.e. tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol. 釜温 and 釜残 refer to the reaction kettle temperature and the kettle residue.

paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入150mL  2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入20g氢化钾(30％，0.15mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: 150 mL of 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol was charged to the reaction kettle and stirring was started; 20 g potassium hydride (30％, 0.15 mol) was added at room temperature and stirred until completely dissolved; after stripping the solvent under reduced pressure with a high-vacuum oil pump, solid potassium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanolate was obtained and kept sealed for later use.
paragraphs.notes: 氢化钾(30％) is translated literally as potassium hydride at 30％; the text does not say what the remaining 70％ is, nor whether the percentage is an assay or a dispersion strength.

paragraphs.zh: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.1g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.2％。
paragraphs.en: To the potassium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanolate was added 200 mL THF; after stirring to dissolve, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 degrees C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total charging time being 3 h; after charging was complete the mixture was held at temperature for 3 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 33.1 g of product. HPLC assay gave a content of 97.0％ of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, a two-step yield of 92.2％ calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: Word for word identical to [0177] except for the alkoxide cation (钾, potassium, instead of 钠, sodium) and the two final numbers, 97.0％ and 92.2％. The isolated product mass 33.1g is the same in both.

drawings.notes: Scheme for Example 18, announced by [0180]. Ring substitution read off the drawing, not inferred: both hexagons are drawn in the same orientation, carboxyl carbon on the upper-left vertex, Cl on the top vertex, the CH2 side chain on the upper-right vertex, and the methylsulfonyl group on the lower-right vertex; the bottom and lower-left vertices carry no substituent. Numbering C1 to C4 runs from the carboxyl carbon in the direction the printed names use. The left-hand structure draws the sodium as a covalent NaO bond to the carbonyl carbon and the reagent draws a covalent OK bond; both SMILES record the conventional ionic reading of those drawings. No stereo bond is drawn at the tetrahydrofuran C2 in either the reagent or the product, so no configuration is assigned. No solvent is written on the arrow.

discrepancies.what: The reaction solvent appears only in the prose, never on either arrow.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The arrows at [0181] and [0187] carry the alkoxide above and HCl below, with no solvent.
discrepancies.text_says: [0183] charges 200mL THF for Example 18 and [0189] charges 70mL DMSO for Example 19.

discrepancies.what: The reagent that generates the alkoxide is written but not drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Both arrows show the preformed alkoxide as the only reagent above them.
discrepancies.text_says: [0182] makes the potassium alkoxide from 150mL 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol and 20g potassium hydride (30％, 0.15mol); [0188] makes the sodium alkoxide from 50mL 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol and 2.8g sodium metal (99％, 0.12mol). Neither the hydride nor the metal is in the scheme.

discrepancies.what: The schemes draw an achiral product while the prose names it as a racemate.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Both product structures use plain bonds at the tetrahydrofuran C2, so no configuration is assigned.
discrepancies.text_says: [0177], [0180], [0183] and [0186] all name the product 2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, with an explicit (RS) descriptor.

discrepancies.what: The two-step yields are stated against a methyl ester that is not the starting material drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Both schemes start from the sodium carboxylate salt.
discrepancies.text_says: [0177] and [0183] report the two-step yield calculated on 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯, the methyl ester, which is the step (1) starting material described on an earlier page.

discrepancies.what: The alkoxide stoichiometry differs between the two examples but the schemes are otherwise identical, so the difference is invisible in the drawings.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Neither arrow carries any equivalents or amounts.
discrepancies.text_says: [0182] uses 0.15mol of potassium hydride and [0188] uses 0.12mol of sodium metal, both against 0.1mol of the benzoate salt.
